data.description:
## Overview
Implement the core causal analysis module that integrates PRISM-Causal with GoT data.

## File References
- Implementation target: cortical/got/causal_analysis.py (NEW)
- PRISM-Causal base: cortical/reasoning/prism_causal.py
- GoT types: cortical/got/types.py
- GoT API: cortical/got/api.py
- Behavioral tests: tests/behavioral/test_got_causal_integration.py

## Key Classes to Implement
- GoTCausalAnalyzer: Main analyzer wrapping GoT store
- Methods: trace_root_cause(), analyze_impact(), find_blocking_chains()
- Methods: calculate_necessity(), analyze_sprint_causality()

## Data Requirements (see CLAUDE.md SOPs)
- Requires DEPENDS_ON edges between tasks
- Requires CAUSED_BY edges for reactive tasks
- Requires started_at/completed_at timestamps
- Requires blocked_reason for blocked tasks

## Acceptance Criteria
- All 18 tests in test_got_causal_integration.py pass
- Integrates with real GoT store (not mock)
- Handles missing data gracefully with warnings
data.title: Implement GoT-Causal core analysis module
